enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Power Store: This item collects and stores magical energy. Any spellcaster can use this energy to partially power their spells. All spells cast while using this item receive an enhancement bonus of -10% to their spell point costs.
Enchantment Focus II: +2 Equipment bonus to the DC of Enchantment spells.
Necromancy Focus II: +2 Equipment bonus to the DC of Necromancy spells.
Concentration +5: Passive: +5 Competence bonus to the Concentration skill.
Spell Penetration III: Passive: +3 Equipment bonus to Spell Penetration checks.

Upgradeable Item (Black Abbot): This item could be upgraded if you found a Seal of the Black Abbot to combine it with. Bring this item to the Fountain of Necrotic Might outside the Black Mausoleum and combine it with a Seal of the Black Abbot to upgrade the item to a more powerful form.

children.tooltip: Potency +48: Passive: +48 Equipment bonus to each Spell Power.
Spellcasting Implement +15: Passive: +15 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.

enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
